async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Issues' link in the project navigation to go to the issues page
    issues_link = page.get_by_role("complementary", name="Project navigation").get_by_role("link", name="Issues")
    await issues_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # On the issues page, click the 'New issue' button to start creating an issue
    # Use get_by_role with exact=False for case-insensitive substring matching
    new_issue_button = page.get_by_role("link", name="New issue", exact=False)
    if await new_issue_button.count() == 0:
        new_issue_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="New issue", exact=False)
    await new_issue_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Fill in the issue title
    title_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title", exact=False)
    await title_textbox.fill("Add support for MT theme editor")
    
    # Fill in the issue description
    # Use get_by_role with exact=False for the description textbox
    description_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Description", exact=False)
    if await description_textbox.count() == 0:
        # If not found, try alternative role or name variations
        description_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox").filter(has=page.get_by_text("Description", exact=False))
    await description_textbox.fill("Request to add support for MT theme editor in a11y-syntax-highlighting to enhance accessibility features.")
    
    # Submit the issue by clicking the 'Submit issue' button
    submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Submit issue", exact=False)
    await submit_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
